changelog:
Initial release of submit-to-meganiche skill:

- Enables submission of authorized software products, projects, or distribution opportunities to the MEGA(niche) moderated marketplace via Agent API.
- Supports both provider (supply) and buyer (channel/distributor intent) submissions with required and optional evidence fields.
- Includes rigorous guardrails for authorization, data privacy, and submission accuracy.
- Details idempotency key usage and API response handling.
- Provides instructions for checking submission status and browser fallback when API is unavailable.
